product_one_liner.value: Speak_ uses recruiter-defined criteria to score and rank job applicants’ resumes, helping recruiting teams identify qualified candidates more efficiently.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage describes Speak_ as a customizable AI recruitment partner that reviews resumes, in a context explicitly aimed at recruiting applicants.

pricing_page.notes: The public homepage has a Pricing section and displays plan information, including a free plan, so it has a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage customer testimonials identify Alpine Home Air, Prepared Hero, and Evidence Action as customers. | named_customers.0: The homepage identifies Alpine Home Air in a customer testimonial from its HR Manager. | named_customers.1: The homepage identifies Prepared Hero in a customer testimonial from its Head of People. | named_customers.2: The homepage identifies Evidence Action in a customer testimonial from its Director of Talent Strategy.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook reports 20 employees for Speak_; 20 falls within the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile locates Speak_ headquarters in Boulder, Colorado, United States; the city is Boulder. | hq_country: The Speak_ company profile gives its headquarters location in Boulder, Colorado, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company profile for Speak_ states it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists recruiting, career, hiring, and interview-related articles; it does not show two or more engineering/technical posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public materials surfaced one Ashby integration article and its single linked setup guide, rather than a multi-article product documentation site or developer portal; this does not meet the stated threshold for public docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Speak_ jobs page says the company has not added any jobs, so it has no open AI/ML role.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Speak_’s privacy notice names GDPR and says its practices comply with relevant data-protection regulations. GDPR is the only one of the listed items named in the legal notice; the page does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS. | compliance_certs.0: The privacy notice names GDPR and makes a general statement that Speak_ practices comply with relevant data-protection regulations.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was March 5, 2025, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; therefore it did not raise in that window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Speak_ job board explicitly says it has not added any jobs, so it is not hiring an SDR, BDR, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated October 12, 2026 update describes substantial candidate-scoring improvements, including refined algorithms and new required-signal functionality. That is a major feature update within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small Speak_ team roster names its co-founder/CEO and the other listed team members; a company profile also identifies Andrea Guendelman as current CEO. The reviewed team and dated profile evidence show no C-level/VP join or departure in the 12-month window, although the sources do not provide a complete employment-history timeline.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The homepage lists only ATS integrations (Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, Workable), not a CRM or sales/marketing system, so the requested list is empty.
